rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server authentication messages
Proxmox Backup Server daemon messages

rule.match: successful auth for user
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: login of $(dstuser)
Proxmox Backup Server: login of the administrator account $(dstuser)
Proxmox Backup Server: first login of $(dstuser) on this server

rule.match: authentication failure; rhost=\S+ user=
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: failed login for $(dstuser) from $(srcip): $(pbs.msg)

rule.match: authentication failure; rhost=\S+ user=\S+ msg=authentication failed$
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: correct password but wrong second factor for $(dstuser) from $(srcip)

rule.match: authentication failure; rhost=\S+ msg=(?:invalid ticket|no authentication credentials provided|ticket with bad signature)
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: request with an expired, missing or invalid ticket from $(srcip)

rule.match: authentication failure; rhost=\S+ msg=(?!invalid ticket|no authentication credentials provided|ticket with bad signature)
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: request refused from $(srcip): $(pbs.msg) (an API token that is wrong, disabled or expired)
[WARN] Proxmox Backup Server: repeated failed logins from $(srcip)
Proxmox Backup Server: $(srcip) keeps presenting an invalid API token; a backup client with a stale token?
[WARN] Proxmox Backup Server: $(dstuser) logged in after repeated failed logins
[HIGH] Proxmox Backup Server: administrator account $(dstuser) logged in after repeated failed logins

rule.match: pam_unix(proxmox-backup-auth:auth): authentication failure
rule.description: PAM: failed Proxmox Backup Server login (reported by rule 131802)

rule.match: ^lookup_datastore failed - datastore '[^']+' is not mounted$
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: datastore $(pbs.datastore) is not mounted
Proxmox Backup Server: datastore $(pbs.datastore) has not been mounted for an hour; its garbage collection schedule cannot run (reported once a day)

rule.match: ^lookup_datastore failed - .*(?:maintenance mode|is being unmounted|is being deleted)
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: datastore $(pbs.datastore) is in maintenance mode or being unmounted

rule.match: ^lookup_datastore failed - Unable to acquire lock
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: the datastore configuration lock could not be taken (usually while the services stop or restart): $(pbs.error)

rule.match: ^lookup_datastore failed - (?!datastore '[^']+' is not mounted$)(?!Unable to acquire lock )(?!.*(?:maintenance mode|is being unmounted|is being deleted|No space left on device|os error 28))
rule.description: [WARN] Proxmox Backup Server: a datastore cannot be opened: $(pbs.error)

rule.match: ^TASK ERROR: (?!.*(?:No space left on device|os error 28))
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: a task failed: $(pbs.error)

rule.match: ^could not notify via target `
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: a notification could not be delivered via $(pbs.target): $(pbs.error)

rule.match: does not have a configured email address
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: a notification recipient has no e-mail address, nothing was sent to it

rule.match: failed to check for TLS handshake|invalid http method for path
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: malformed connection to the API port from $(srcip)
Proxmox Backup Server: repeated malformed connections to the API port from $(srcip) (probe or scan)

rule.match: ^got (?:reload|shutdown) request
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: a daemon is reloading or shutting down (update, restart or certificate change)

rule.match: ^reloading certificate
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: the API certificate was replaced and reloaded

rule.match: No space left on device|os error 28
rule.description: [HIGH] Proxmox Backup Server: out of disk space (No space left on device); backups to the datastore fail

rule.match: ^(?:TOTP of user '[^']+' is locked|refusing 2nd factor for user '[^']+')
rule.description: [WARN] Proxmox Backup Server: the second factor of $(dstuser) is locked after repeated wrong codes; someone who knows the password keeps trying

rule.match: ^unable to start (?:garbage collection job on datastore|datastore (?:prune|sync|verification) job|tape backup job) (?!.*(?:is not mounted|maintenance mode|is being unmounted|is being deleted))
rule.description: [WARN] Proxmox Backup Server: a scheduled job could not be started: $(pbs.error)

rule.match: ^task scheduler(?: panic|: | failed - )
rule.description: [HIGH] Proxmox Backup Server: the task scheduler failed, scheduled jobs do not run: $(pbs.error)

rule.match: ^(?:unable to read (?:datastore|prune job|sync job|verification job|tape job) config - |(?:datastore|prune job|sync job|verification job|tape backup job) config from_value failed - |unable to parse schedule '|compute_next_event for '[^']*' failed - |could not get last run time of )
rule.description: Proxmox Backup Server: the task scheduler cannot read a job configuration or schedule, the job is skipped: $(pbs.error)

rule.match: ^(?:can't verify chunk, load failed - |can't verify missing chunk with digest |can't verify chunk with digest |Failed to verify the following snapshots/groups:)
rule.description: [WARN] Proxmox Backup Server: a verification found corrupt or missing chunks; see the verification task log

rule.match: cannot remove protected snapshot|only partially deleted due to protected snapshots
rule.description: [WARN] Proxmox Backup Server: a request to delete protected backups was refused (request $(protocol) $(url), client $(srcip))
Proxmox Backup Server task result
